content.text:
This order is for the Wednesday 2026-10-07 Alder (V1) delivery. It covers 7 days through Sunday plus 2 buffer days: 9 cases of AW-CHK20 chicken (est $657.00), 2 cases of V1-EGG and 4 cases of V1-CHEESE. The estimated total is $887.40, under your $1,000 limit.

The assumption that most changes the quantities is that INV-099 (40 lb chicken, due 2026-10-06) isn't counted, because it isn't physically confirmed received (note:N15). That follows your inbound.on_hand_rule=physical_confirmation. Eggs and cheese include your 25% weekend brunch uplift (order.brunch_uplift=0.25).

Before approving, decide two things:
- **INV-099:** If it is likely to arrive, you'd carry about 40 lb of extra chicken. Say so in `ask` and the proposal shrinks.
- **Chicken runway:** 47.9 lb covers about 2.0 days, but the first feasible delivery is 2 days away. Ask Alder about an earlier drop or a pickup.
